item.text:
Research continuation completed across all eight chapters without scoring.

The worker filesystem was read-only and the shell failed at container setup, so I could not persist `research-ledger-manifest.json`. The following additions and disposition changes are ready for parent application.

### 1B — Nuclear responsibility

- **R4-001 — Chinese Ministry of National Defense, 23 Feb 2023.** Defense spokesperson reaffirmed no-first-use, self-defense, no arms race, and minimum-force doctrine. Precise locator: official press-conference item. Direct institutional attribution; final evidence for 1B.2, 1B.4, 1B.7. [MND statement](https://eng.mod.gov.cn/xb/News_213114/TopStories/16203784.html)
- **R4-002 — Arms Control Association, June 2023.** Open-source evidence does not establish a coherent Chinese nuclear objective; modernization may support retaliation or future coercive capability, but there is “not much evidence” of an adopted first-use posture. Final contrary/context evidence for 1B.3, 1B.7, 1B.10. [ACA analysis](https://www.armscontrol.org/act/2023-06/features/unknowns-about-chinas-nuclear-modernization-program)

Remaining gap: no direct Xi procurement order or nuclear/radiological crisis.

### 2B — International peace and restraint

- **R4-003 — China–India WMCC, 31 May 2023.** Chinese and Indian officials agreed to maintain diplomatic and military communication, promote de-escalation, and preserve border peace. Institutional attribution; final contrary-restraint evidence for 2B.1, 2B.7, 2B.10. [FMPRC readout](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/eng./xw/wjbxw/202405/t20240530_11343481.html)
- **R4-004 — Xi–Putin joint statement, 21 March 2023.** Xi signed a statement supporting dialogue, respect for international law, prevention of escalation, and settlement of the Ukraine crisis. Direct Xi attribution; final evidence, while noting the contradiction between stated peace language and support for Russia. [FMPRC statement](https://www.fmprc.cn/mfa_eng/gjhdq_665435/3265_665445/3220_664352/3222_664356/202303/t20230322_11046088.html)
- **R4-005 — Xi–Zelensky call, 26 April 2023.** Xi stated that China stood for peace and negotiations. Direct Xi attribution; final contrary evidence for 2B.1, 2B.6, 2B.7. [State Council report](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202304/26/content_WS64493013c6d03ffcca6eca92.html)

No 2023 lethal Chinese cross-border incident or confirmed Chinese arms transfer to Russia was recovered.

### 3B — Domestic protection

- **R4-006 — National Bureau of Statistics, 2023 child-development monitoring.** Official 2023 data report lower infant and under-five mortality, expanded child-health coverage, improved compulsory-education retention, and increased access for migrant children. Official outcome evidence; indirect state attribution and positive contrary evidence for 3B.3, 3B.7, 3B.10. [NBS report](https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202501/t20250124_1958440.html)
- Retain named HRW/Amnesty cases, but split each victim, sentence, disappearance, and institutional outcome into separate ledger units. Do not attribute them personally to Xi without additional direction or knowledge evidence.

COVID mortality estimates remain disputed and should remain qualified, not treated as settled facts.

### 4B — Political freedom

- **R4-007 — Beijing government work report, January 2023.** Official report states that Beijing worked under the “strong leadership” of the CPC Central Committee with Xi at its core and records repeated Xi inspections and instructions. Direct evidence of formal authority and implementation chain, not proof of every local outcome. [Beijing report](http://wb.beijing.gov.cn/en/center_for_international_exchanges/headlines/202301/t20230128_2907664.html)
- **R4-008 — NBS/official 2023 statistics.** Housing redevelopment, subsidized rental housing, water-use outcomes, and environmental indicators provide implementation evidence and positive counterweight to purely repression-focused coverage. [NBS communiqué](https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202402/t20240228_1947918.html)

No precise 2023 election, succession, or term-limit event was found.

### 5B — Economic prosperity

- **R4-009 — Ministry of Finance implementation report, November 2023.** Reports 2023 education spending of RMB 4.2166 trillion, increased compulsory-education funding, support for rural schools, student-loan relief for approximately four million graduates, and increased social-security, education, and healthcare expenditure. Official implementation evidence; indirect attribution. [MOF report, pp. 8, 22–27](https://www.mof.gov.cn/en/reports/202311/P020231129565240759289.pdf)
- **R4-010 — NBS household data, first three quarters of 2023.** Reports urban disposable income growth of 5.2%, rural growth of 7.6%, and increased spending on education and healthcare. Official outcome evidence; useful contrary evidence to a uniformly negative economic account. [NBS household survey](https://www.stats.gov.cn/english/PressRelease/202310/t20231026_1943920.html)

Retain property deterioration and youth-data suspension as separate contrary units. IMF snippets remain rejected.

### 6B — Social well-being

- **R4-011 — National Healthcare Security Administration, 28 July 2023.** Sets resident medical-insurance financing at RMB 1,020 per person, including a minimum RMB 640 government subsidy; targets approximately 70% inpatient reimbursement and 99%+ coverage for low-income rural residents. Official implementation evidence for 6B.2, 6B.3, 6B.5. [NHSA policy interpretation](https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2023/7/28/art_105_11110.html)
- **R4-012 — Ministry of Finance report.** Records increased healthcare expenditure, public-hospital reform, pension transfers, and support for vulnerable groups. Positive contrary evidence for 6B.2, 6B.3, 6B.5. [MOF report](https://www.mof.gov.cn/en/reports/202311/P020231129565240759289.pdf)
- **R4-013 — NBS child-development report.** Provides 2023 health, education, safety, food, and welfare outcomes, including 95.7% compulsory-education retention and expanded child-health services. [NBS report](https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202501/t20250124_1958440.html)

Education, housing, water, sanitation, and food coverage is now improved, but remains predominantly official and indirect.

### 7B — Personal integrity

- **R4-014 — Xi at CCDI plenum, January 2023.** Xi set anti-corruption priorities covering finance, SOEs, judicial and public-security sectors, and misuse of officials’ family influence. Final evidence of explicit oversight responsibility, not personal honesty. [State Council report](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/topnews/202301/11/content_WS63be0c99c6d0a757729e5529.html)
- **R4-015 — Xi-chaired inspection review, September 2023.** Xi chaired review of the first 20th-Central-Committee inspection report and called for rectification and intensified anti-corruption work. Final evidence of corrective institutional action. [State Council report](https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202309/28/content_WS65153b2ac6d0868f4e8e2e74.html)
- **R4-016 — CCDI 2023 totals, published January 2024.** Reports 626,000 cases opened and 610,000 people disciplined in 2023. Institutional accountability evidence only; not personal-integrity evidence. [CCDI statistics](https://www.scjc.gov.cn/scjc/zhyw01/2024/1/25/c5070445dd934b0a81b874cb6a2991f9.shtml)

No direct 2023 Xi asset, family-benefit, personal-corruption, truthful-disclosure, or broken-promise event was recovered. Keep that gap explicit.

### 8B — Effectiveness and competence

Reuse R4-006, R4-009, R4-010, R4-011, R4-014, and R4-015 as separate implementation, outcome, adaptation, and correction units. They add:

- quantified education, healthcare, social-security, and student-support implementation;
- positive household-income and service outcomes;
- explicit Xi-directed administrative oversight;
- documented inspection-based correction.

Aggregate results remain mixed, and no score is assigned.

### Disposition changes

- Upgrade R4-001, R4-003, R4-004, R4-005, R4-006, R4-009–R4-015 to `final_evidence`.
- Retain IMF/World Bank snippets, unopened Bloomberg material, post-period Amnesty material, and unsupported personal-wealth claims as `rejected` or `context`.
- Split all bundled HRW, NDRC, BBC, and Guardian entries into atomic source-claim units.
- Do not count local priors or same-family publications as independent source families.
- Manifest persistence could not be completed because the worker filesystem is read-only.
